name: qr
expr: [Q, R] = qr(A); err1 = max(max(abs(Q*R - A))); orth1 = max(max(abs(Q'*Q - eye(3)))); [Qt, Rt] = qr(At); err2 = max(max(abs(Qt*Rt - At))); orth2 = max(max(abs(Qt'*Qt - eye(3)))); [Qe, Re] = qr(At, 'econ'); qeC = size(Qe,2); reR = size(Re,1); errE = max(max(abs(Qe*Re - At))); orthE = max(max(abs(Qe'*Qe - eye(2))));
comment: Sig: [Q, R] = qr(A) | qr(A,'econ'). Householder QR; A = Q*R, Q orthogonal. Tested on 3x3 + 3x2 tall. 'econ' on the 3x2 tall matrix: Qe 3x2, Re 2x2 (k=min(m,n)=2), Qe*Re=At, Qe'*Qe=I2. Q signs may differ from MATLAB by reflection; fingerprint uses abs() on R diagonal + reconstruction/orthogonality errors to be sign-agnostic.
